images.title: Cube differences settle at level 3
images.purpose: Shows the cubes 1, 8, 27, 64 and 125 with their differences taken three times until they become the constant 6.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A downward triangle of four rows of numbers in the centre, with one tag on the last row.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 4 rows of numbers, centred, each row set between the numbers above it. Row 1, dark: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125 (5 numbers). Row 2, teal (#0072B2): 7, 19, 37, 61 (4 numbers). Row 3, amber (#E69F00): 12, 18, 24 (3 numbers). Row 4, reddish purple (#CC79A7): 6, 6 (2 numbers), with a reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded box around it and the tag level 3: constant beside it. Thin grey (#6B7280) slanted lines join each number to the two numbers above it. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Differences of cubes become constant at the third level, of squares at the second.
images.description: Shows the cubes 1, 8, 27, 64 and 125 with their differences taken three times until they become the constant 6.

image_decisions.why: A small difference triangle shows the level by level pattern far more clearly than a list.
